reason: Cubature owns cubic scheduling, lighting, lifetime, storage and DH runtime compatibility/optimization patches; Riven owns generated content

qualification.status: Cubature 1.12.2-0.1.4.0, built for Cleanroom from a clean checkout of this commit; 276 Cubature tests and 80 lab tests, 0 failures. riven.ps1 quick (every ci job) passed with this pin. Native runs of fresh Riven worlds with this build and Riven on its build pool: a PREFETCH lifecycle flight-and-settle (every scenario passed; 14,905 unloads and no loads while standing, the 20,538-cube floor), and a BASELINE land route with 8 DH workers and the LOD trace (every scenario passed; saved blocks of 82,287 cubes away from spawn match a world built on the previous pin, under identical block registries). Server logs show only the known missing MixinItemMap and duplicate furnace-recipe warnings.
qualification.contents: Version 0.1.4.0 with Orthrus Research as copyright holder and vendor and compile-only build inputs that a standalone clone fetches; since the initial commit, the manual CI workflow's build-input step, deliveryMode as the only delivery input, the periodic autosave as a named provider call, explicit delivery generation timing with run-or-await for work in flight, sender-chosen PacketCubes sizing, a provider and lighting that reach the player cube map only through CubeDemand and SurfaceHeightListener, held teleports kept when a teleport leaves the player in place, PlayerCubeMap, CubeProviderServer and the lab's Python tools split into focused parts, the delivery system in its own core.server.delivery package behind a boundary test, every numeric setting ranged and checked on sync and by the set command, and every test source run on both loaders, every test source run on Cleanroom, the Java 8 Forge fallback retired, and a bounded build pool offered to the generator through ICubeGenerator.useBuildPool (generatorBuildThreads).
limits: Respawn, portal and join arrivals still load their column synchronously
qualification.knownExistingWarning: Missing MixinItemMap remains; held-map behavior unqualified
